concept: SettingsLayout is the back panel of an appliance where every setting is printed in a fixed place: a title, then boxes of settings, each setting a name and its small print on the start side and the part that sets it on the end side. Rows are parted by seams, and on a narrow unit the part drops under its name instead of squeezing it.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a SettingsLayout drawn as a stack of white cards, one per section, each with a bold heading and a soft drop shadow
default_to_avoid.why_not: A raised card per section spends depth on a grouping, which is printing and not a part, and a page of cards puts boxes inside the unit's own body.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a settings page of loose rows with a switch floated far from its label across the full width
default_to_avoid.why_not: When the part sits a whole page away from its name, the eye loses the pair, and nothing draws the extent of the group.

references.source: Braun T 1000 world receiver (Dieter Rams, 1963): back and side panels with every function printed in a fixed place, grouped in boxes with the name on the line
Braun RT 20 radio (Dieter Rams, 1961): controls in a ruled grid, each key with its word printed beside it
apps/lab/settings-layout/index.html: printed box per section, margin heading, raised panel per section

derivation.consequence: a group of related parts sits inside one printed box
derivation.form: Each section's rows stand inside one hairline box in line.ring with corner.media, so the extent of the group is drawn and not implied.

derivation.consequence: labels sit on the body's inset line, never floating mid-surface
derivation.form: Every row prints its name and small print against the inline-start edge of the box, and the part stands at the inline-end edge, so the name is never in the middle of the surface.

derivation.consequence: fixed positions, so a unit's layout does not reflow between states
derivation.form: A row holds its place whatever the part inside does; the only reflow is by width, when the part drops under its name on a narrow unit.

derivation.consequence: every part keeps ≥44px hit area even when it draws smaller
derivation.form: A row is never shorter than layout.touch, so a switch or a field inside it keeps its full target with room to spare.
The title is a Heading one step above the section headings, so size alone tells page from section; the row name is body size and the small print caption size in secondary ink.

derivation.consequence: labels name their control through aria-labelledby
derivation.form: Each section is a region named by its heading through aria-labelledby, and a row hands its name and small print ids to the part so it can point at them.

options.name: printed box per section, heading above the box
heading in a margin column, rows parted by seams only

variants.reason: A closes each group on four sides and keeps the name above it, so both the extent and the name are printed and a phone-width unit keeps its full row. B puts the heading in a margin column that takes a third of a 400px unit, so a field drops under its name even in the first row. C spends the unit's material height on a grouping, which makes every section look like a card.

root.why: A single column with a token gap between title and sections, so the page keeps one fixed rhythm and does not reflow between states.

title.why: The page title, one Heading level above the section headings, set on the inset line and naming the whole layout.

intro.why: An optional line of small print under the title in secondary ink, tied to the layout as its description.

section.why: A region that holds one heading and one printed box of rows, named by its heading through aria-labelledby.

sectionHeading.why: The section name, a Heading a step below the title, printed above the box on the inset line; its id names the region.

sectionIntro.why: An optional note under the section heading in caption size and secondary ink, read out as the region's description.

box.why: The hairline box in line.ring with corner.media and no fill or shadow, so it is a printed line on the body and not a card.

row.why: One setting: a flex row at least layout.touch tall that wraps, so the part keeps its size and drops under the name when the unit is narrow.

seam.why: A Divider between two rows, flat on the body; it is drawn only between rows, so the first row has no seam above it.

text.why: The column of name and small print, sitting on the inline-start edge and taking the room the part leaves.

label.why: The setting's name in body size and primary ink; its id is passed to the part for aria-labelledby.

description.why: The setting's small print in caption size and secondary ink; its id is passed to the part for aria-describedby.

control.why: The part that sets the value, at the inline-end edge at its own size, never stretched to fill the row.

data-disabled.why: A disabled row fades its name and small print together; the part inside is disabled by the caller, so the whole row goes flat at once.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the box keeps a real border in the system text colour so the extent of each group survives.
